text:
Noah: Quick thread  we need a concise benchmark narrative for launch week: hero visual + one-page benchmark mini-report + 30s vertical for socials. Key metric: median latency vs $/1k tokens, highlight p95 tail. Who can own each piece?

Rina: I can own the mini-report (PDF) and the hero headline. Sam/Vik take charts?

Sam: I9ll do the plots. Want raw inference cost only or end-to-end (infra + egress + infra ops)?

Noah: End-to-end please. Customers care about real bills. Add a tiny assumptions footer.

Vik: Dropping a small CSV baseline — synthetic but representative. Use Nimbus variants and OpenTuna as open baseline.

Vik: ```
model,variant,mode,median_ms,p95_ms,usd_per_1k
nimbus-6b,quant,hosted,16,88,0.12
nimbus-6b,quant,dedicated,13,72,0.10
nimbus-6b,quant,private,17,95,0.09
opentuna-7b,fp16,hosted,38,220,0.07
opentuna-7b,fp16,dedicated,34,190,0.06
opentuna-7b,fp16,private,41,250,0.05
```

Sam: Great. Ill make two chart formats: (1) scatter with median on x-axis, $/1k on y-axis, color=mode, size=p95; (2) three-column panel: median, p95, cost with a short takeaway over each.

Leah: Ill write hero copy and two CTA variants: dev-focused and enterprise. Draft hooks: dev="Fast defaults, predictable bills"; enterprise="SLA-backed serving with clear unit economics". Which is primary?

Noah: Make dev primary for paid social and socials, enterprise for sales follow-ups. Keep CTAs: button A "Try hosted API" (utm=bench_dev) and button B "Talk to sales" (utm=bench_enterprise).

Rina: Mini-report structure: 1) one-sentence summary, 2) chart + 3 bullets, 3) appendix with assumptions & calc example, 4) how to reproduce tests. Will include a small table with raw numbers.

Vik: Analytics plan: tag clicks with utm_campaign=bench_launch_v1 and set event `bench_download` for PDF. Also create lead property `bench_interest` with values "dev" or "enterprise."

Sam: ETA: static PNGs + CSV export by 6pm PT. GIF/vertical 30s to design by 9pm PT?

Leah: I can hand off microcopy for the 30s vertical to design by 7pm PT. Keep script under 60 characters per card.

Rina: For the appendix calc: example line: "At $0.10 /1k tokens, 5k queries of 1k tokens = $500."

Noah: Also request: add a short "why p95 matters" microcopy next to the p95 chart: one sentence.

Sam: Will annotate p95 callouts: "p95 shows tail latency that affects user experience under load."

Vik: For colors use brand teal (hosted), slate (dedicated), and graphite (private). Ill add hex codes in the analytics CSV so design matches.

Leah: Social text draft: "See how latency and cost line up across deployment modes. Benchmark report + live demo during launch webinar. Link in bio." Short alt copy for accessibility included.

Noah: Checkpoints: Sam (charts) -> 6pm, Leah (copy + social) -> 7pm, Rina (PDF) -> 10pm, Vik (tracking) -> after assets. If anything slips call me.

Sam: Uploading first PNGs to #marketing-assets in ~3h. Will include plot code snippet for reproducibility.

Rina: Ill assemble PDF once I have final PNGs; will include reproducibility steps and raw CSV.

Vik: Will prepare GTM tag config in Growth and post once assets are live.

Leah: Adding two CTA variants for the signup form: dev_flow and enterprise_flow.

Noah: Thanks all. If the scatter looks clean well use it as the hero; otherwise use the three-panel. :raised_hands:
